paper_title: First results of the CERN Resonant WISP Search (CROWS)
notes: CROWS microwave LSW experiment. Paper reports two limits: HSP (dark photon, kinetic mixing chi) and ALP (axion-photon g). The novel result probing unexplored parameter space is the HSP/dark photon limit: chi = 4.1e-9 at m_gamma' = 10.8 ueV (from HSP run Sept 2013). Only the single most-sensitive text point is extractable; full exclusion curves are in Fig 14 but numerical values not tabulated. The ALP result (g = 4.5e-8 GeV^-1 at m_a = 7.2 ueV, AxionPhoton) is a separate limit. LSW experiment, no DM density assumption. 95% CL. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.75, 42)) | Vision: FIG. 14 shows HSP (dark photon) exclusion with kinetic mixing chi vs HSP mass. The CROWS 9/2013 region is a V-shaped light-blue region with most sensitive point at m_gamma=10.8 ueV (1.08e-5 eV), chi=4.1e-9. The boundary rises steeply on both sides due to mass-dependent geometric form factor. Lower boundary traced; excluded region is above/inside. The ALP plot in FIG.13 uses g_agamma coupling instead.
